ctaHeading: Melbourne's electronics experts are ready to help.
aboutText: Radio Parts has been Melbourne's trusted supplier of electronics since 1935. With over 85 years of experience, we offer a wide range of products and services to both trade and retail customers. Our team is dedicated to providing expert advice and quality solutions for all your electronics needs. Visit us in Melbourne for personalised service and comprehensive support.
servicesText: We specialise in hi-fi systems, TV and radio installation, AV distribution, and more. Our services cover professional audio, CCTV, intercom, alarms, and IT networking. From residential to commercial, Radio Parts has the expertise to handle any electronics project in Melbourne.

services.title: Hi-Fi & Audio Systems
services.desc: Expert setup and consultation for hi-fi systems, speakers, and audio equipment. Ideal for home and studio use.

services.title: TV & Radio Installation
services.desc: Professional installation of TVs, radios, antennas, and satellite systems. Enjoy clear reception and optimal performance.

services.title: AV Distribution & Communication
services.desc: Seamless AV distribution for homes and businesses, plus CB radio and communication devices. Stay connected everywhere.

services.title: CCTV, Intercom & Alarm Systems
services.desc: Secure your property with our CCTV, intercom, and alarm installations. Tailored security solutions in Melbourne.

services.title: IT Networking & Data
services.desc: Complete IT network setup including data cabling, components, and testing. Reliable connectivity for all devices.

services.title: Electrical & Accessories
services.desc: From appliances and lighting to leads, cables, and batteries. All your electrical essentials under one roof.
